injuries.name: Rasmus Dahlin
injuries.note: out

injuries.name: Josh Norris
injuries.note: Norris could be facing an absence depending on further tests. The 27-year-old will be at risk of missing Saturday's game versus the Canadiens at a minimum. If Jiri Kulich (undisclosed) is also out, Tyson Kovak would likely draw into the Sabres' lineup.

injuries.name: Jiri Kulich
injuries.note: Kulich's absence wasn't clarified prior to the contest. Sam Carrick replaced him in the lineup while Peyton Krebs moved into a top-six role. Kulich is day-to-day ahead of the Sabres' game versus the Canadiens on Saturday.

injuries.name: Alex Lyon
injuries.note: According to the team, Lyon was originally expected to be in the crease for Tuesday's road clash with Montreal before suffering his setback. Even once given the all-clear, there may not be enough games to go around to make Lyon more than a low-end fantasy target, especially as long as Buffalo continues rostering three goalies.

injuries.name: Matt Grzelcyk
injuries.note: Buffalo placed Grzelcyk on injured reserve Tuesday. He hasn't played since Opening Night against Columbus on Oct. 1. With Rasmus Dahlin (upper body) and Grzelcyk unavailable, the Sabres recalled Dennis Gilbert from AHL Rochester to play against Montreal on Tuesday.

injuries.name: Jason Zucker
injuries.note: Zucker has spent the start of the regular season recovering from offseason sports hernia surgery, and while he appears to be trending in the right direction in his rehab process, head coach Lindy Ruff said Tuesday that the 34-year-old will still require "a couple of weeks" before he's cleared for game action. Zucker made 62 regular-season appearances for Buffalo last year and recorded 24 goals, 21 assists, 57 hits, 23 PIM and 21 blocked shots while averaging 15:37 of ice time.

injuries.name: Conor Timmins
injuries.note: After getting hurt in Saturday's preseason finale against Pittsburgh, Timmins is on injured reserve for the beginning of the 2026-27 campaign. He registered eight assists, 44 shots on goal, 81 blocked shots and 29 hits in 39 regular-season appearances with Buffalo in 2025-26.

injuries.name: Topias Leinonen
injuries.note: Leinonen will probably report to AHL Rochester when he's ready to return to game action. He sustained the injury during the offseason.

injuries.name: Jack Rathbone
injuries.note: ir-nr

injuries.name: John Tavares
injuries.note: Tavares collided with a Sabre and came away worse for wear, leaving the game immediately. The Maple Leafs should know more in the coming days regarding the 36-year-old's status. Toronto hosts the Islanders on Saturday. Tavares had two assists prior to his exit, giving him seven points through seven contests this season.

injuries.name: Miles Wood
injuries.note: ir

injuries.name: Chris Tanev
injuries.note: Tanev landed on injured reserve Sunday after he suffered an upper-body injury against Colorado on Saturday. Thursday's update indicates that he'll likely need to spend more than the minimum amount of time on injured reserve before he's in the mix to return to game action. Nick Blankenburg will likely continue to see time in Toronto's lineup while Tanev is sidelined.

injuries.name: Dakota Joshua
injuries.note: Joshua was already considered week-to-week, and this move reinforces that he's going to be out for a while. More specifically, he will be forced to miss at least Toronto's first 10 games, and it's possible he will be on the shelf for longer than that. The 30-year-old had 10 goals, 18 points, 49 PIM and 195 hits in 55 regular-season appearances in 2025-26.

injuries.name: Max Domi
injuries.note: There's no timetable for Domi's return after he had complications while undergoing surgery over the summer. The 31-year-old had 12 goals, 36 points and 95 PIM in 80 regular-season appearances with Toronto in 2025-26. Domi will likely serve in a middle-six capacity once he's ready to return.

injuries.name: Cade Webber
injuries.note: ir-nr

injuries.name: Elvis Merzlikins
injuries.note: Less than 24 hours after Merzlikins was traded to the Maple Leafs, a timetable for his return to action has been provided. The 32-year-old backstop had an up and down season in 2025-26, where he posted a 14-11-3 record, a 3.39 GAA and an .883 save percentage across 30 regular-season outings. He won't be rushed into action, as the Leafs new goaltender tandem of Sergei Bobrovsky and Anthony Stolarz are still expected to handle the majority of reps between the pipes this upcoming season. However, when Merzlikins is ready to return, he's the clear No. 3 option in Toronto's organization and could still see some playing time at the NHL level if he isn't sent down to AHL Toronto.

injuries.note: Shoulder: The Columbus Blue Jackets placed G Elvis Merzlikins on injured reserve on Friday (Sept. 25) and is expected to miss 4-6 months to begin the 2026-27 regular season while recovering from a shoulder injury.
